shellCommands.command: git status --short && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50

cat app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json __agent_eval__/run.mjs; git diff package.json; ls node_modules/next/package.json && node -e "console.log(require('/workspace/node_modules/next/package.json').version)"
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "tsc exit: $?"; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -20

(PORT=3123 npx next start > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code} in %{time_total}s\n" -A "curl-test" http://localhost:3123/; sleep 1; grep -A6 "analytics" /tmp/next.log; pkill -f "next start" ; git status --short
rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && git checkout tsconfig.json && npx tsc --noEmit; echo "tsc exit: $?"; git status --short
